clean_source_blocks.text: The record company executive also worked with Billy Joel, Pink Floyd, Alicia Keys and Aerosmith.

Clive Davis, one of the most influential music executives in the history of rock and pop, has died at the age of 94. A former head of Columbia and Arista Records, he signed and shaped the careers of artists including Aretha Franklin, Bruce Springsteen, Billy Joel, Whitney Houston, Santana, Janis Joplin, Christina Aguilera, Alicia Keys and many others. He had recently been in hospital with respiratory problems and was recovering at home in Manhattan, New York, when he died, his family said. "To the world, our father was the iconic music legend whose vision, instincts, and relentless pursuit of excellence shaped the soundtrack of countless lives," they said in a statement. "He discovered, mentored, and championed the greatest artists in modern music history, leaving an indelible mark on culture that will endure for generations.

"To his family, Clive was Dad and Granddaddy, the steady presence at the centre of our lives, the source of wisdom, strength, encouragement, and unconditional love." Among those paying tribute was Bruce Springsteen. In a post on Instagram, the Born in the USA singer said that he was mourning the death of "the great record man" and a "close friend". "At 22 years old, he changed my life when he signed me to Columbia Records," Springsteen wrote. "He treated me with the same respect and kindness as a 22-year-old nobody as he did after all my success. A great man." Another former client and rock iconoclast Patti Smith also posted on Instagram following news of his death.

original_article.research:
[Lähde: BBC World]
Clive Davis, one of the most influential music executives in the history of rock and pop, has died at the age of 94.

A former head of Columbia and Arista Records, he signed and shaped the careers of artists including Aretha Franklin, Bruce Springsteen, Billy Joel, Whitney Houston, Santana, Janis Joplin, Christina Aguilera, Alicia Keys and many others.

He had recently been in hospital with respiratory problems and was recovering at home in Manhattan, New York, when he died, his family said.

"To the world, our father was the iconic music legend whose vision, instincts, and relentless pursuit of excellence shaped the soundtrack of countless lives," they said in a statement.

"He discovered, mentored, and championed the greatest artists in modern music history, leaving an indelible mark on culture that will endure for generations.

"To his family, Clive was Dad and Granddaddy, the steady presence at the centre of our lives, the source of wisdom, strength, encouragement, and unconditional love."

Among those paying tribute was Bruce Springsteen.

In a post on Instagram, the Born in the USA singer said that he was mourning the death of "the great record man" and a "close friend".

"At 22 years old, he changed my life when he signed me to Columbia Records," Springsteen wrote. "He treated me with the same respect and kindness as a 22-year-old nobody as he did after all my success. A great man."

Another former client and rock iconoclast Patti Smith also posted on Instagram following news of his death.

"Thanking Clive Davis for transforming music, and on a very personal note, for believing in me, shepherding my efforts and a half century of your love and support."

Born in Brooklyn on 4 April, 1932, he grew up in the Crown Heights neighbourhood.

He graduated from Harvard Law School and had no knowledge of the music industry when he took a job at Columbia Records at the age of 28 - but he took night classes to educate himself on copyright law, contracts and litigation.

Davis used that knowledge to help defeat a federal antitrust suit over Columbia's mail-order record club; and successfully persuaded Bob Dylan to remain with the label, after his original deal became void when the singer turned 21.

He was promoted to vice-president of the record label in 1965 and shortly after became president. Among the acts he signed were Santana, Aerosmith, Pink Floyd and Springsteen, giving the label a new lease of life.

payload.title: Musiikkivaikuttaja Clive Davis on kuollut 94-vuotiaana
payload.summary: Columbia Recordsin ja Arista Recordsin entinen johtaja Clive Davis vaikutti keskeisesti useiden rock- ja popartistien uriin. Perheen mukaan hän kuoli kotonaan Manhattanilla New Yorkissa toivuttuaan hengitysvaikeuksista.
payload.content:
Clive Davis, yksi rock- ja popmusiikin historian vaikutusvaltaisimmista levy-yhtiöjohtajista, on kuollut 94-vuotiaana. Davis tunnettiin urista, joita hän auttoi käynnistämään tai muovaamaan: hänen vaikutuspiiriinsä kuuluivat muun muassa Whitney Houston, Bruce Springsteen, Aretha Franklin, Billy Joel, Santana, Janis Joplin, Christina Aguilera, Alicia Keys, Aerosmith ja Pink Floyd.

## Pitkä ura levy-yhtiöissä

Davis oli Columbia Recordsin ja Arista Recordsin entinen johtaja. Hänet ylennettiin levy-yhtiön varapääjohtajaksi vuonna 1965, ja pian sen jälkeen hänestä tuli yhtiön presidentti. Hänen kaudellaan Columbia sai uutta voimaa useista kiinnityksistä, joihin lähdeaineiston mukaan kuuluivat Santana, Aerosmith, Pink Floyd ja Springsteen.

Davisista tuli musiikkialalla hahmo, jonka arviointikyky ja vaikutus artistien uriin ulottuivat useisiin sukupolviin. Hän työskenteli sekä rockin ja soulin keskeisten nimien että myöhempien poptähtien kanssa. Lähdeaineistossa hänen kerrotaan löytäneen, mentoroineen ja tukeneen monia modernin musiikin tunnetuimpia artisteja.

## Kuolema Manhattanilla

Perheen mukaan Davis oli ollut hiljattain sairaalahoidossa hengitysvaikeuksien vuoksi ja toipui kotonaan Manhattanilla New Yorkissa, kun hän kuoli. Perhe kuvasi lausunnossaan häntä musiikkilegendaksi, jonka näkemys, vaisto ja tinkimätön pyrkimys huippuosaamiseen vaikuttivat lukemattomien ihmisten elämän ääniraitaan.

Perhe korosti myös Davisin yksityistä puolta: läheisilleen hän oli isä ja isoisä, vakaa läsnäolo sekä viisauden, voiman, rohkaisun ja ehdottoman rakkauden lähde. Lausunnon mukaan hänen kulttuuriin jättämänsä jälki kestää sukupolvelta toiselle.

## Springsteen muisteli ystäväänsä

Bruce Springsteen muisteli Davisia Instagramissa suurena levymiehenä ja läheisenä ystävänä. Springsteenin mukaan Davis muutti hänen elämänsä, kun tämä kiinnitti hänet Columbia Recordsille 22-vuotiaana. Springsteen kirjoitti, että Davis kohteli häntä samalla kunnioituksella ja ystävällisyydellä uran alussa kuin myöhemmin menestyksen jälkeenkin. Myös Patti Smith muisti Davisia kuolinuutisen jälkeen.
summary_bullets: Clive Davis on kuollut 94-vuotiaana New Yorkissa.
Davis johti urallaan Columbia Recordsia ja Arista Recordsia sekä vaikutti useiden tunnettujen artistien uraan.
Bruce Springsteen muisteli Davisia läheisenä ystävänä ja uransa kannalta ratkaisevana henkilönä.
